name: Integration for CF7 and Mollie
author: SRX Webdesign

sections.description:
Contact Form 7 mollie integration helps you to integrate Mollie in your Contact Form 7. Please follow the guides carefully. Thanks.

Docs and support

  1. Go to settings and navigate to CF7 mollie Settings. Give your mollie API key and select forms you want to integrate. Select currency and Give redirect url.

  2. Make a contact form 7 form.

[text* your-email placeholder “Your Email”]
[number* payment-amount placeholder “Payment Amount”]
[submit “Pay with Mollie”]

  1. Now go to the page you added the contact form 7. You are good to go.

Demo

https://test.srxwebdesign.com/cf7-mollie/
